apiKey.description: API key (Dashboard > API Keys). Takes priority over username and password; use an admin key to see all user sessions

username.description: Jellyfin username, used when no apiKey is set

password.description: Jellyfin password, used with username when no apiKey is set

useWebSocket.description: Live updates via the Jellyfin WebSocket, falling back to polling

stoppedDisplaySeconds.description: Seconds a stopped session stays visible (0 disables)

updateInterval.description: Seconds between polls (used when the WebSocket is unavailable)

showUserAvatar.description: Show the user avatar (initials when there is no picture)

showPoster.description: Show the poster or album cover

showTranscode.description: Show a badge over the poster while transcoding (requires showPoster)

showMultipleUsers.description: Show all sessions, otherwise only the first

hideWhenIdle.description: Hide the module when nothing is playing

fontSize.description: Base font size, using MagicMirror's size classes

textFontSize.description: Subtitle and other text font size (any CSS font-size)

posterWidth.description: Poster width (any CSS length); album covers are 1.5x this

headerTemplate.description: Header when there are streams. Supports {header_text}, {play_count}, {user_count}

headerTemplateZero.description: Header when there are no streams. Supports {header_text}, {play_count}, {user_count}

playbackLocation.description: Show local, remote, or all sessions

mediaTypes.description: Media types to filter on (empty means all)

mediaTypeFilterMode.description: Treat mediaTypes as an allow or block list

userFilterMode.description: Treat users as an allow or block list

userMapping.description: Map a Jellyfin username to a display name

debugSessionData.description: Log the session data (very noisy; also needs MagicMirror debug logging)
